mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC for UNRATE > 5.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO both declining) fails to predict negative 60d returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
